soil_problem: Subsoil hardpans in Irugur and Palladam red soils — restricts root penetration, causes moisture stress, Nitrogen and Zinc deficiency.
physical_fix: Cross-plough with a heavy-duty chisel plough at 50 cm intervals to shatter the hardpan up to 45 cm depth.
chemical_fix: Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) as basal dose. Split Nitrogen (Urea) applications to prevent leaching.
biological_fix: Spread 12.5 t/ha of Farmyard Manure (FYM) or composted coir pith to prevent pan from reforming. Apply Azospirillum to fix atmospheric nitrogen.

soil_problem: Alkaline heavy clay Vertisols (Peelamedu series) cause surface crusting when wet, wide cracks tearing roots when dry. High pH locks out nutrients.
physical_fix: Construct lateral drainage channels. Add sand/tank silt to improve capillary water movement and drainage.
chemical_fix: Apply agricultural Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) to displace bound sodium from clay, followed by leaching. Dose: 2.5 t/acre.
biological_fix: Incorporate green manures like Daincha (Sesbania bispinosa) before sowing to release natural organic acids that lower pH. Also apply Trichoderma viride.

soil_problem: Alkaline soils (pH > 7.5) bind Phosphorus to Calcium, making it unavailable for early root development and nitrogen-fixing nodular bacteria.
physical_fix: Conduct early summer tillage to enhance soil oxidation and nutrient release.
chemical_fix: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP) to provide readily available Phosphorus and Sulphur. Rate: 250 kg/acre.
biological_fix: Treat seeds with Rhizobium (fixes N) and apply Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) to the soil to break Calcium-Phosphorus bonds organically.

soil_problem: Intensive farming on highly calcareous soils causes severe nutrient immobilization — 'Pencil point disease', yellowing fronds, hollow nuts, button shedding.
physical_fix: Dig circular trenches around the palm base to conserve moisture.
chemical_fix: Administer 200 mL of TNAU Coconut Tonic directly into root vascular system every 6 months to bypass alkaline soil.
biological_fix: Supplement soil basin with composted coir pith treated with Pleurotus fungi to improve organic carbon. Apply Azospirillum + PSB mixture.

soil_problem: Continuous rice-rice cropping in Anaimalai and Noyyal river belts creates 'fluffy paddy soils' with low bulk density — poor seedling anchorage, Zinc starvation.
physical_fix: Compact the fluffy topsoil by passing a 400 kg stone roller or sand-filled oil drum over semi-dry field 8 times.
chemical_fix: Apply Lime at 2 t/ha once every 3 years to stabilize the soil. Add ZnSO4-enriched fertilizers (25 kg/ha).
biological_fix: Dip seedling roots in Azospirillum slurry (500 g/ac) before transplanting. Apply Phosphobacteria to enhance nutrient availability.

soil_problem: High active calcium carbonate induces Iron chlorosis (leaf whitening/yellowing) and Zinc deficiency ('Little leaf' in mango, rosette in chillies).
physical_fix: Utilize drip fertigation for precise water-soluble nutrient delivery directly to root zone.
chemical_fix: Apply foliar sprays directly to leaves: 0.5% ZnSO4 and 0.25-1.0% Ferrous Sulphate at critical growth stages.
biological_fix: Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-inoculants and organic humic acid extracts to naturally chelate nutrients. Use vermicompost as base amendment (1 t/acre).

soil_problem: Low soil nitrogen causes stunted growth, yellowing of older leaves, and significantly reduced yield potential.
physical_fix: Deep ploughing to incorporate surface organic matter. Maintain at least 5 cm mulch layer.
chemical_fix: Apply Urea (46% N) in split doses: 50% basal, 25% at tillering, 25% at panicle initiation. Rate varies by crop.
biological_fix: Apply Azospirillum biofertilizer (2 kg/acre) — fixes 20-40 kg N/ha from atmosphere. Incorporate green manure (Dhaincha or Sunhemp) 45 days before sowing.

soil_problem: Phosphorus deficiency causes purple discolouration of leaves, poor root development, delayed maturity, and reduced grain filling.
physical_fix: Avoid waterlogging which immobilizes phosphorus. Ensure proper drainage.
chemical_fix: Apply DAP (18-46-0) or SSP as basal dose before sowing. Rate: 50-100 kg/acre depending on crop.
biological_fix: Apply Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) — 2 kg/acre as soil application or seed treatment. PSB can solubilize locked phosphorus equivalent to 25 kg DAP.

soil_problem: Potassium deficiency causes scorching of leaf margins (leaf scorch), weak stalks, poor fruit quality, and reduced disease resistance.
physical_fix: Apply wood ash (natural potassium source) at 500 kg/acre if available from farm waste.
chemical_fix: Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP, 60% K2O) or Sulphate of Potash (SOP) at 50-80 kg/acre as basal.
biological_fix: Apply Potassium Mobilizing Bacteria (KMB) — 2 kg/acre. Incorporate composted banana pseudostem (rich in K) as organic amendment.

soil_problem: Extreme soil acidity (pH < 5.0) causes aluminum and manganese toxicity, severely limits nutrient availability, and creates hostile root environment.
physical_fix: Lime the field thoroughly. Deep plough after liming to incorporate lime into root zone.
chemical_fix: Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) at 2-4 t/acre based on soil buffering capacity. Apply 3 weeks before sowing minimum.
biological_fix: After liming, apply biofertilizer consortium (Azospirillum + PSB + KMB) and incorporate FYM at 5 t/acre to restore soil microbial life.

soil_problem: Extreme soil alkalinity (pH > 8.5) causes sodium toxicity, calcium carbonate cementation, and near-complete lockout of iron, zinc, manganese and phosphorus.
physical_fix: Install drainage channels to leach excess salts. Subsoil ploughing to break calcareous hardpan.
chemical_fix: Apply Gypsum (4-6 t/acre) to reclaim alkaline soil. Follow with heavy leaching. Apply sulphur powder (500 kg/acre) to acidify over 2-3 seasons.
biological_fix: Plant Dhaincha (Sesbania) as green manure — its roots exude organic acids reducing pH naturally. Apply sulphur-oxidizing bacteria post-amendment.
